value.rationale: The directed three-cycle is the smallest irreducible one-way cyclic Markov generator with wraparound terms in the RK4 polynomial. The theorem replaces a nine-entry polynomial positivity test with two rate-order statistics and gives an exact nonreentrant timestep and sharp mode-change parameter for a natural rate-heterogeneous family. This materially distinguishes spurious negative holding probabilities from spurious negative direct transitions in chemical master-equation stepping. Not a generic asymptotic extrapolation or renaming of the known homogeneous result.
